releaseNotes: Added an evidence-led editorial scrollytelling capability that maps situation, mechanism, outcome, and proof to stable semantic scene states without copying a source site's visual identity.

Replaced equal-section scroll quantization with measured step-center geometry, one shared reversible controller, responsive stage composition, and explicit no-JavaScript, reduced-motion, and Save-Data behavior.

Added a typed landing surface contract, static validator, pure geometry fixtures, and LaunchBench failures for synchronization drift, short mobile layouts, copy-to-visual disconnects, and incomplete fallbacks.
Bound the capability to the existing Design Room and local landing workflow, with browser evidence required before an active landing can pass.

Added the Formation Craft Lens and a validator-backed reasoning contract for physical models, structural motion, mobile recomposition, native-medium presentation, restraint, precise microinteractions, concept comparison, and convergence.
Added distribution proof, a lifecycle-aware signal corpus, and traffic-backed offer testing to the founder-owned pre-build Go, Pivot, or Kill decision.

Added structured content intelligence, owned-relationship metrics, manual-before-automation proof, and persona-balanced beta guidance without weakening existing launch, UGC, operations, or release requirements.
Preserved fresh-context verification for completed final-batch work when a session ends through cooperative yield without repeating the verifier at ordinary empty-frontier completion.

Required explicit CTA conversion counts, complete Craft Lens reasoning before substantive mutation, and an applicability decision plus a structured passed manual-run result before value-producing automation.
Required real non-future calendar dates across new signal and offer-test records, and required superseded signal records to resolve to a distinct declared replacement.
Added a strict research workflow-output gate, bounded whole-number offer measurements by exposure, and required signal supersession chains to be acyclic and terminate at usable evidence.
Added an exact fence-aware Markdown table adapter and required every manual-loop, offer-decision, measurement, and waiver row to stay structurally valid instead of selecting one valid-looking row.

Limited cooperative-yield verification to exact fresh-context attempts produced by completed batches, and made Signal Corpus not-applicable status parsing fence-aware and fail-closed for duplicate or malformed declarations.
Added a release-date Apple source gate that checks live upcoming requirements, submission baselines, Xcode compatibility, and upload guidance against the local build host before each archive.
Added compiled-archive bundle, version, and build reconciliation with App Store Connect, including a guard against leading-zero version segments.
Kept the supplied Apple Developer Forums thread as historical failure evidence while routing policy decisions to current official Apple documentation.
Extended the Apple signing workspace packet, workflow contract, validator fixtures, and LaunchBench coverage to enforce the seven-item release preflight.
Rejected unchanged Apple signing scaffolds and required ISO-dated, resolved pass evidence for every release preflight item.
Split intended pre-archive checks from new-archive inspection, attached the validator to the release workflow, and rejected stale or contradictory sign-off evidence.
Added a strict release-node gate and structural bundle, version, and build comparison so unresolved or mismatched identity evidence cannot pass by label alone.
Ordered privacy proof before signing verification and bound post-archive approval to the current archive path, creation timestamp, and Info.plist fingerprint.
Verified release evidence against the real compiled archive, separated build uniqueness from App Store Connect equality, and rejected negated readiness states.

Made every substantive Signal Corpus table fence-aware and duplicate-safe, added bounded conflict-row semantics, and clarified persona-balanced beta worksheets as optional planning rather than app-quality completion proof.
Moved Distribution Proof onto the same exact fence-aware table contract while preserving its source-ledger, signal-resolution, and measured-evidence semantics.
